correctness.rationale: Derived zero-current stationary law from coupled forward transport equations, then recomputed the exact log derivative. Fourfold hyperbolic identity gives cubic Q, whose strictly negative second derivative and Q(1)<0 prove all modal cases. Explicit rational admissible parameters give three exact signs, two simple roots, and three nondegenerate maxima. Implicit-function theorem establishes an open full-dimensional three-peak phase. The standalone verification code passed 6407 checks; sample tests are supporting evidence rather than proof of the global count.

A strict three-peak phase under admissible switching rates refutes the completeness of a widely used one/two-mode assumption and cannot be inferred from center curvature alone.
